segments.text:
V. 9.
Who were hired about the eleventh hour—Either the Gentiles, who were called long after the Jews into the Vineyard, the Church of Chriſt; or thoſe in every Age, who did not hear, or at leaſt underſtand the Goſpel-Call, till their Day of Life was drawing to a Period. Some Circumſtances of the Parable ſeem beſt to ſait the former, ſome the latter of theſe Senſes.
